page.overview:
Who is Dinoco Girls?

"Those nine blue-feathered beauties on deck at the Dinoco publicity tent, they're the "Dinocuties." They're the last dancers standing after a fierce international competition in which the gals all lived in a giant dorm and competed for dominance on television. On the final episode, The King, Strip Weathers, hand-picked the winners."

In the film, they are first seen performing on the Dinoco stage after the Motor Speedway of the South race. In Lightning McQueen's daydream of being sponsored by Dinoco, two of the girls are seen beside him (with one of them kissing him on the cheek) before we see his paint being changed. They also appear in McQueen's dream of Frank winning the Piston Cup, where one of them kisses him, making him roar loudly.
